verses.text: Yahweh told Moses, ‘Come up to me with Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders. Bow down and worship from a distance. 🙏
‘Moses alone may come close to Yahweh. The others must stay back, and the people must not come up the mountain with him.’ 🏔️
Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words and instructions. Everyone answered together, ‘We’ll do everything Yahweh has said.’ 🤝
Moses wrote down all Yahweh’s words. He got up early, built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and set up twelve pillars for Israel’s twelve tribes. 🪨
He sent young Israelite men to offer burnt offerings and sacrifice cattle as peace offerings to Yahweh. 🐂
Moses put half the blood in bowls and splashed the other half against the altar. 🩸
Then he took the covenant scroll and read it aloud to the people. They said, ‘We’ll do everything Yahweh has said. We’ll obey.’ 📜
Moses took the blood, splashed it on the people, and said, ‘Look, this is the covenant blood Yahweh made with you through all these words.’ 🩸
Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and Israel’s seventy elders went up the mountain. 🏔️
They saw Israel’s God. Under his feet was something like a sapphire pavement, clear like the sky. 💎
God didn’t harm Israel’s leaders. They saw God, and then they ate and drank. 🍽️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Come up the mountain and stay with me. I’ll give you the stone tablets with the law and commands I wrote, so you can teach the people.’ 📜
Moses got up with Joshua his attendant, and they climbed God’s mountain. 🏔️
He told the elders, ‘Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur are with you. If anyone has a dispute, they can go to them.’ ⚖️
Moses went up the mountain, and the cloud covered it. ☁️
Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day, Yahweh called Moses from inside the cloud. 🌩️
To the Israelites watching, Yahweh’s glory at the mountain’s summit looked like a fire consuming everything. 🔥
Moses entered the cloud and climbed the mountain. He stayed there for forty days and forty nights. ☁️
